summary.overall_assessment: Core routing, graph traversal, and research enrichment are predominantly data-driven, but several narrow regexes, concept-specific special cases, and two hardcoded static book/chapter replies exist in route_special_books.py and route_logic.py.

hardcoded_or_narrow_findings.description: Returns a hardcoded 5-paragraph comparative book recommendation (OSTEP vs Silberschatz with specific chapter numbers 26-34, 32, 5-7) without querying the live catalogue or graph.
Returns a hardcoded summary of OSTEP Chapter 28 (Pages 301-320) while explicitly noting 'A local PDF page has not been verified', bypassing passage retrieval.
Fullmatch conditional for a specific phrasing of 'neural network' that returns a hardcoded 3-sentence GENERAL_EXPLANATION string instead of routing through graph/LLM synthesis.
Concept-ID-specific conditional preventing 'eigenvalues and eigenvectors' from routing to MULTI_CONCEPT when two concepts are extracted.
Hardcoded abbreviation fallback for '3nf' -> 'third_normal_form' inside SHELF_RE handling rather than using the graph label index.

Gates GENERAL_EXPLANATION fallback when best_score < KILL_SWITCH. Unindexed academic topics in Compilers, TOC, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Linear Algebra, or Probability that lack these 9 tokens fall into GUARDRAIL_INTERCEPT (OOD_MESSAGE).
Hardcoded 18-term academic comparison allowlist; comparisons of unindexed concepts outside this list fall through to DISCONNECTED instead of GENERAL_EXPLANATION.
Includes domain-specific tokens 'dbms' and 'b+' in a generic comparison cue tuple.
Narrow exact-phrase regex for a single capability question variant.

legitimate_deterministic_controls.description: Input validation and security guardrails (EMPTY, INJECTION -> PERSONA_LOCK, CODE_TRAP).
Conversational greeting and CAPABILITY_INQUIRY responses dynamically reading graph node count.
Institutional administrative routing (SCHEDULE, AUTH_GATEWAY) via compose.admin_card.
Deterministic source provenance and citation linking (best_book, pearson_line, link_answer_sources, citation_link).
Live Koha OPAC lookup and institutional catalogue shelf routing (_route_shelf_query).
Live SQLite/research topic inventory (_inventory_answer) and keyword-scored saved paper evidence attachment (enrich_with_research).
